prompt: The climbing club’s notice said, “The last two places were not reserved for beginners only.” Its coordinator then confirmed that a returning member with a valid booking had used one of those places; a beginner who arrived without booking had been turned away. Taken together, the notice and the coordinator’s account indicate that _____.
promptZh: 攀岩社的公告寫道：「最後兩席不只保留給初學者。」協調員隨後確認，一名預約有效的舊會員用了其中一席；一名沒預約就到場的初學者則被拒。綜合公告與協調員的說法可知，_____。

options.text: the places were not set aside for bookings of any kind, although a returning member happened to have booked
options.zh: 這兩席沒有保留給任何預約，只是剛好有位舊會員事先預約
options.whyZh: 不能將 not 的作用讀成「沒有保留座位」；上下文否定的是「只限初學者」。

options.text: the places were still exclusively for beginners, but one of them was opened to returning members after all bookings ended
options.zh: 這兩席仍僅限初學者，只是預約全部結束後才將其中一席開放給舊會員
options.whyZh: 未說預約已結束或後來才放寬。舊會員用的是有效預約。

options.text: beginners could claim the places without booking, but returning members had to book them
options.zh: 初學者可不經預約取得這兩席，舊會員則必須事先預約
options.whyZh: 未預約的初學者被拒，不能從非排他推論初學者免預約。

options.text: having a booking could qualify a returning member as well; beginner status alone did not secure a place
options.zh: 有預約的舊會員也有資格；僅有初學者身分不足以取得一席
options.whyZh: only 限定適用的人；舊會員有有效預約也取得一席，而初學者身分本身不足。

explanationZh: only 限定適用的人；舊會員有有效預約也取得一席，而初學者身分本身不足。
evidence: were not reserved for beginners only / a returning member with a valid booking / a beginner who arrived without booking had been turned away

vocabulary.note: 可指有人到場後因名額或資格等原因沒能進入。
